newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Electric says 1996 sales up 12.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila Electric says 1996 sales up 12.2 pct.

text.p: Manila Electric Co, the country's largest electricity distributor, said on Monday its sales rose by 12.2 percent to 17.81 billion kilowatt-hours (kwh) in 1996.
The full-year sales figure exceeded the company's earlier projections of an eight to ten percent growth for 1996.
Meralco's higher-than-expected sales were brought about by greater economic activity with Gross National Product (GNP) growth in 1996 expected to be at least 7.1 percent in 1996, analysts said.
For December alone, the company's sales jumped by 18.5 percent to 1.474 billion kwh from the year-earlier month.
For the full-year sales, residential and commercial customers logged the biggest growth rates at 12.9 percent each, while industrial clients were at 10.9 percent.

Residential customers usually account for the biggest share at 33.7 percent. This was followed by the industrial sector, 33.3 percent; commercial segment, 32.2; and the rest were accounted for by streetlights.
